name: edgecart.
tagline: Predicts produce ripeness on store shelves and prices it dynamically to cut food waste.

awards: Best Financial Hack by Capital One
YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator
Build on the Knot TransactionLink API by Knot API

problem: Grocery stores waste large amounts of produce with blanket discounts that come too late or too early.
solution: Vision models assess ripeness from shelf images and drive personalised discounts at the right moment, with transaction data linking purchases.
demo_moment: Team-described: point a camera at bananas and see their discount change.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Financial Hack by Capital One” and “YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator” and “Build on the Knot TransactionLink API by Knot API” among 195 submissions.
Won three sponsor prizes including the YC challenge.

lessons: Scope to one shelf and show the money saved.
